headline.text: Alcohol and alprazolam together produce additive central nervous system depressant effects

reported.text: The label states that benzodiazepines including alprazolam produce additive central nervous system depressant effects when combined with other depressants such as ethanol.

claims.text: The label states alprazolam with CNS depressants including ethanol produces additive CNS depressant effects.
claims.quote: The benzodiazepines, including alprazolam, produce additive CNS depressant effects when coadministered with other CNS depressants. Prevention or management Limit dosage and duration of XANAX during concomitant use with CNS depressants [see Warnings and Precautions (5.3) ] . Examples Psychotropic medications, anticonvulsants, antihistaminics, ethanol, and other drugs which themselves produce CNS depression.
